## Section 3.5 — drop beta-converted studies (Extraversion)

- Dropped: A-28 A-30. Asynchronous r = -0.083 [-0.880, 0.837] (k = 2); mixed-online r = 0.043 [-0.078, 0.163] (k = 4).
- Modality test: F(1, 4) = 2.25, p = .208.
- Published: '-0.121 -> -0.095', '+0.059 -> +0.044', 'The headline interaction effect is qualitatively robust under all three scenarios.'

## Table 3 — interaction model (withdrawn)

- Rows: 42 (study × trait) from only 9 studies; rows are not independent, so the published SEs, t-tests and the joint Wald test (χ²(4) = 13.64, p = 0.0085) are not valid.
- The E × M coefficient (+0.385) equals (E_M − E_A) − (O_M − O_A) = (+0.159) − (-0.226): 59% of it reflects Openness (the reference trait), not Extraversion.
